summary: Reads CHOP channel and audio files from disk or URLs into channel data, including .chan, .clip, .bclip, .aiff, and .wav workflows.

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Channel/audio file path or http URL

key_params.name: nameoption
key_params.note: Use names in file, new names, or filename

key_params.name: name
key_params.note: Channel name when using new names

key_params.name: rateoption
key_params.note: No change, override, or resample sample rate

key_params.name: rate
key_params.note: Sample rate used by override or resample mode

key_params.note: Default value for default extend mode

key_concepts: Reads CHOP channel and audio files from disk or the web into CHOP channels.
Official supported examples include .chan, .clip, .bclip, .aiff, and .wav file types.
MIDI files are routed to MIDI In CHOP rather than File In CHOP.
Name Options controls whether loaded channels use names in the file, a new explicit name, or the filename.
Rate Options can preserve the file sample rate, override the declared rate, or resample channel data.
Left and Right extend conditions, rename patterns, value override, and refresh controls can preprocess loaded data before downstream use.
common_gotchas: Use http:// explicitly for URL reads.
Override changes the sample rate metadata without resampling; Resample actually converts the channel data.
Large source rates can create very large arrays unless rate handling is deliberate.
File In CHOP is for channel/audio files; MIDI files should use MIDI In CHOP.
Extend and rename parameters affect downstream sampling and exports, so preserve intended channel names.
